description: This PHP source file defines a custom view class AOS_ContractsViewDetail, which extends the base ViewDetail class. It handles displaying contract details, populating a dropdown list with PDF templates from the database, and rendering HTML for a popup to select templates for PDF generation within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: AOS_ContractsViewDetail
classes.description: A custom view class for displaying contract details, managing template selection and popup rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the class by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to populate templates and show the HTML popup, then calls parent display.

methods.name: populateContractTemplates
methods.description: Queries the database for active PDF templates of type 'AOS_Contracts' and updates the global list for use in dropdowns.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML and JavaScript to display a popup for selecting a PDF template, including handling single/multiple templates cases.
